oracles.kmp: Direct character comparisons at every start for 280 random cases; exact overlap, singleton/longer-pattern cases and 200000-character adversarial runs
oracles.string_hashing: Direct per-substring Horner recomputation for all intervals of 160 random strings; 200000 uniform queries checked by independent modular geometric-series formula; exact fingerprint trace

collision_scope: Verifies specified fingerprints, not collision-free equality; toy modulus-five collision checked separately. No invented probability guarantee.
